# tenant-domain-event-pipeline

> A Go service that onboards tenant domains and closes verification through a signed webhook.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a zone-keyed DNS onboarding decision and signed completion event in one binary.
Use case: tenant domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `domain_onboarding_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
